a1-zeo-sec.heading: ZeoCharge & Ferment (the first remedy under Gut-Toxin & Die-Off Tools: a zeolite powder taken in water, and a fermented juice)
a1-zeo-sec.for: a reader learns which zeolite to get and how to prepare and take it; the first two paragraphs (the ferments) are settled and stay; read from "Most sober people" to the end
a1-zeo-sec.moment: you are about to take a psychedelic, or to sit with a friend who has, and you want zeolite ready for when the trip turns sick in the gut; you are deciding what to buy, how to prepare it and how to give it

asis-bmg-sec.heading: Beach Morning Glory (the first remedy under "Need to Stop the Trip?": a beach plant whose leaf he uses to end a psychedelic trip)
asis-bmg-sec.for: a reader learns what beach morning glory is, what it does to a trip, how much of it does what, and how to handle and give it; read all of it
asis-bmg-sec.moment: you are sitting with a friend whose psychedelic trip has gone bad enough that they want it over, or whose nausea won't stop; you have heard beach morning glory can end a trip and you are deciding whether to give it, and how much
